entries.title: Hub Rebuild & Navigation
items: Rebuilt the hub around the new Astral Forge background artwork.
Added Daily Reward and Event buttons with in-hub Coming Soon popups.
Added the top-right Account & Settings dropdown.
Added Player Account, Settings, Update Log, Help & Support, About, and Sign Out actions.
Locked the Android experience to landscape orientation.

entries.title: Battle & Game Systems
items: Expanded the battle screen foundation and sprite pipeline.
Added character and monster animation asset support.
Added game settings, music, haptics, and performance preferences.
Added player stats and allocatable attribute points.
